capture_rule: Capture the complete NIST TRC ThermoML JSON record for DOI 10.1016/j.fluid.2018.12.005 and preserve the raw source byte-for-byte. Retain every directly reported experimental real-gas vapor-liquid-equilibrium dataset, every source row in source order, all compound and phase identities, every temperature, pressure, liquid and gas composition, uncertainty, method and provenance field, and all pure-component and validation-system records. Do not use Peng-Robinson, Wong-Sandler, NRTL, correlated, regressed or model-calculated values as measurements, and do not discard adverse, duplicate, endpoint, validation-system or boundary rows.
environment_rule: Each target is identified only by the DOI, complete-source identity, PureOrMixture dataset ordinal and source point ordinal before values open. Compounds, temperature, pressure, composition, phase, equilibrium result, uncertainty and target hash remain withheld targets.
identity_rule: No compound name or identifier, condition, composition, phase value, equilibrium class, uncertainty or target hash enters an identity row.
property_rule: Retain every direct experimental binary real-gas equilibrium record whose ThermoML metadata binds gas and liquid phases and reports pressure and/or phase composition under a declared temperature. Preserve the complete raw record and all companion direct datasets even when they are not part of the matched multicomponent vector.

source.archive_authority: NIST Thermodynamics Research Center ThermoML Archive
